recipes.name: Strawberry Mango Salsa with Baked Pita Chips
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 400°F (210°C)*.
Spread the butter evenly onto the pita rounds, then cut each pita into eight equally-sized wedges. Transfer to the baking tray.
Stir together the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl, then sprinkle onto the pita wedges. Bake for 7 minutes, or until crisped to your liking.
Add all of the salsa ingredients to a medium bowl and mix.
Serve the salsa with the pita chips and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store the salsa in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 day.
